parts.label: Sun
parts.note: Its heat powers the whole cycle

parts.label: Evaporation
parts.note: Warm water turns into invisible vapour and rises

parts.label: Condensation
parts.note: Vapour cools into tiny drops that make clouds

parts.label: Precipitation
parts.note: Water falls back as rain, snow or hail

parts.label: Snow on the peaks
parts.note: Some is stored as snow and ice

parts.label: Collection
parts.note: Water gathers in the sea, ready to rise again
